items.title: Disjoint closed subsets are separated by a global function in the vanishing situation

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a global function separating two disjoint closed subsets inside the vanishing situation: it takes the value zero on one and the value one on the other (statement lines 3071-3076). The proof endows the subsets with their reduced structures, checks surjectivity of the comparison map to the direct sum of the two structure sheaves at geometric stalks, and uses the vanishing of $H^1$ on the kernel to lift the global section $(0,1)$ to the ring. The surjectivity check and the lifting are the substance, so the claim is H2.
